name: sol_defi_lending_8
description: LTV/health-factor calculation omits accrued interest, causing incorrect credit/liquidation assessment
question: The source file in `source` computes a loan's Loan-to-Value ratio or health factor using only the principal (or a stale debt snapshot) while excluding currently accrued but unrealized interest, causing the calculated LTV to understate the true debt owed and leading to incorrect borrowing limits or premature/delayed liquidations, and this does not apply if the code explicitly fetches or computes up-to-date accrued interest (e.g., via an interest accrual/index update call) before performing the LTV or liquidation comparison.
criteria: calculateLTV() divides collateralValue by principal debt only, never adding accrued interest to the debt figure
isLiquidatable() or health factor check compares collateral to debt.principal without calling accrueInterest() or reading updated borrowIndex first
getUserDebt() returns a stored debt amount from the last update timestamp without applying the interest rate over elapsed time before it is used in LTV math
Liquidation threshold comparison uses cached/outdated debt snapshot taken before interest accrual for the current block
